speaker: john_heminges
text: The— the reckoning stands thus. Doors open, house stood, the ordinary costs out before anyone is witty.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The house stood. The doors open again next week. That is the speech I came to make, and it is short.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Short is welcome. I can bear a short reckoning better than a long one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John, say the figure before we make a story out of a week.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Your share, Will, eight-and-twenty shillings. Last Saturday was four-and-thirty. This is not last Saturday. It is coin.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Eight-and-twenty. I will take it. The jig paid the yard in noise. I am not asking a second share for noise.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I was first in the slippers, and the noise was mine. I asked in March, and I was answered with a jig. The jig is spent. Pay the share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The share is the pay, same as the rest. Item, no extra for slippers. Item, nothing paid out of this sheet but the share.

speaker: james_burbage
text: No extras. Eight-and-twenty is what the week left. I have heard it. I am not hearing it dressed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take it home. I am not counting the chest in this room. The share is the share.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Sensible. Four-and-thirty last week was a kinder week. Eight-and-twenty is this one. I am not asking you to average them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys are not on this sheet. I am not opening a column for a second bowl.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then there is no such column. The sheet is the shares. I start a sentence once, and I finish it. The share is said.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Good. Eight-and-twenty, and the doors. Somebody write it. I am not staying to invent a loss.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Write the slippers in the margin as a glory, not a cost, or write nothing. Thursday kept me a quarter of an hour. This room will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The glory is already in the yard. It does not need a line in John's book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It will not get one. Will, eight-and-twenty. Say it back, so the room has heard one number.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight-and-twenty shillings. Last Saturday four-and-thirty. I have both, and I am taking this one.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Both, and no third. Augustine, the cittern survived him. That is a profit the sheet cannot see.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The cittern survived. The slippers can stay where they were left. I am for home.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The house stands. That is the news. I am not making it longer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I am longer than the news, and I am leaving. You played a duke, Will. I played a cobbler. We are paid the same. I can live once with a world that wrong.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once. Do not make it a doctrine. John, we are done if the number is said.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The number is said. Eight-and-twenty. The doors next week as they were. I am shutting the book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Shut it. I want my supper more than I want a second total.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut. I am going home.
